document_metadata.title: 1、INT. KOWOLSKI'S BAKERY - KITCHEN - DAY
document_metadata.summary: A news crew covers the Kowolski Bakery's 30th anniversary, featuring a giant chocolate chip cookie made by brothers Gustov and Vol, surpassing Buffalo's previous record; Bruce Nolan reflects on its symbolism for the city's pride and community.

entities.name: Bruce Nolan struggles with hair and resists wearing a hair net
entities.description: Bruce Nolan attempts to fix his hair before the broadcast and reacts with dismay when required to wear a hair net due to health code regulations, complaining about the lack of preparation and calling it undignified.

entities.name: Ally Loman enforces health code requirement for hair net
entities.description: Ally Loman, the segment producer, informs Bruce Nolan that a hair net is mandatory for being on camera near the cookie due to health regulations, despite his objections and frustration.

entities.name: Bruce Nolan transforms into charismatic news reporter on cue
entities.description: At the count of one, Bruce instantly shifts from being visibly annoyed to delivering a polished, smooth news report in his professional 'reporter's voice' for the camera.

entities.name: Bruce Nolan reports on Kowolski Family Bakery's 30-year legacy
entities.description: Bruce narrates a segment highlighting the Kowolski Family Bakery's three decades of operation, their signature pierogis, and their cultural impact in downtown Buffalo.

entities.name: Gustov and Vol Kowolski reveal origin of giant cookie idea
entities.description: Gustov explains that the idea for the giant cookie came from Vol, who suggested making the biggest chocolate chip cookie in Buffalo, which Gustov immediately agreed to.

entities.name: Bruce Nolan compares new cookie to previous Buffalo record
entities.description: Bruce notes that the previous record for largest cookie in Buffalo was 3 feet, 17 inches by Gladys Pelsnick, and states that the Kowolski brothers' cookie clearly surpasses it.

entities.name: Kowolski family celebrates with milk toast
entities.description: After Bruce's report, the Kowolski brothers, Mother Kowolski, and bakery employees celebrate the anniversary and giant cookie by toasting with large mugs of milk.

entities.name: Kowolski Family Bakery 30 Year Anniversary Celebration
entities.description: A public celebration marking three decades of operation by the Kowolski Family Bakery, featuring a giant chocolate chip cookie, media coverage, and participation by family members and employees.
